cues: Non-cyclic uses both photosystems, has an open path from water to NADP plus, splits water, and makes ATP, NADPH and oxygen, mainly in the grana.
Cyclic uses photosystem one alone, in a closed loop, splits no water and makes only ATP, mainly in the stroma lamellae.
text: A four mark comparison. Non-cyclic uses both photosystems, has an open path from water to NADP plus, splits water, and makes ATP, NADPH and oxygen, mainly in the grana. Cyclic uses photosystem one alone, in a closed loop, splits no water and makes only ATP, mainly in the stroma lamellae.
